# Pantry restock thresholds

The pantry restocks when any shelf falls below a third full, not when it is empty. Restocking at empty left two days a month with no oats or rice, and those were the two days the Friday group came in. A shelf at a third is a day and a half of stock at the current pace, which covers the supplier's lead time.
